summary: Iteration 10 — Full validation of scraper diagnostics + broader-pagination fix (backend + frontend). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_scraper_playwright_fix.py (13 existing + 4 new code-level TestDiagnosticsCodeLevel cases). All regression tests confirmed: test-connection returns ok=false + 'Giriş başarısız' + debug_screenshot; 1-day backfill returns days=1/ok_count=0/fail_count=1 with results[0].debug_screenshot present; backfill validation (invalid start, end<start, range>62) returns 400; list/get/put endpoints unchanged; GET /api/admin/scraper/debug/{filename} serves image/png with auth + rejects non-.png. New assertions verify (a) scraper.py _extract_table_rows returns total_seen/newest_date/oldest_date/pages_visited/rows keys, (b) max_pages=100 (was 50), (c) _try_set_page_size_100 helper is invoked, (d) ScrapeResult has diagnostics + debug_screenshot fields, (e) server.py success-path return payload includes both 'diagnostics' and 'debug_screenshot', (f) _navigate_and_extract ALWAYS captures a screenshot. Frontend: E2E flow via Playwright — /admin/scraper loads (admin-scraper-page), Etobahis accordion expands, all 4 action buttons visible (scraper-test-connection/run-now/backfill/save), Toplu Çekim dialog opens with defaults start='2026-08-01' and end=yesterday (2026-08-06). Executed a real 1-day backfill (today=2026-08-07) with fake creds — result panel renders '0 / 1 gün başarılı · 1 hata', per-day row shows '✗ Giriş başarısız — kimlik bilgileri hatalı olabilir veya captcha var' + working 'screenshot' link pointing to https://gaming-ledger-pro.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin/scraper/debug/scrape_fail_f7c95df5.png (matches ${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/admin/scraper/debug/<filename> pattern). Cleanup done: scraper_configs for Etobahis reset to enabled=false, username='', password_enc unset. base_url + 6 mappings + last_run_summary preserved as instructed.

critical_code_review_comments: scraper.py:389 — result.debug_screenshot on success path = dep_stats.get('screenshot') OR wd_stats.get('screenshot'). Only one screenshot is exposed at top-level even though per-section screenshots exist inside diagnostics dict. Consider surfacing BOTH (deposits_screenshot + withdrawals_screenshot) in diagnostics so users can see EACH section's final state on ambiguity — minor enhancement.

server.py:3830 — Failure-path summary dict does NOT include 'diagnostics' key (understandable since scraper failed before extraction — no diagnostics data available). Return payload on failure also lacks 'diagnostics' — the frontend uses r.diagnostics with optional-chaining so no bug, but code review comment: consider explicit 'diagnostics': None for schema consistency.

scraper.py:191 _try_set_page_size_100 — Iterates ALL combobox triggers looking for text '10/25/50/100'; if the source page has multiple such comboboxes (e.g. status filter also has such), it may click the wrong one. Suggest narrowing selector to be within the transactions table's toolbar (e.g. by proximity to 'Sayfa başına satır' text) — non-blocking.

scraper.py:240 max_pages=100 + 500ms wait/page → worst case 50s per section per day just on pagination waits. For a 62-day backfill * 2 sections * 100 pages that's up to ~1.7h of pure wait time even if all rows found quickly. Consider breaking early once oldest_date scanned is >target_iso_date (already covered by `if seen_earlier: break`, so likely OK). Non-blocking.

AdminScraper.jsx:568-572 — Diagnostics badge shows only total_seen for Y and Ç, but not newest_date/oldest_date/pages_visited. When ok=true but row_count=0, admin can't tell whether it was 'source has 0 completed txns that day' vs 'we didn't paginate far enough to reach that day'. Consider adding oldest_date + pages_visited to the badge or hover tooltip — medium priority for debugging the original 2026-08-01 bug.

AdminScraper.jsx:585-597 — Failure branch also renders screenshot link but no diagnostics badge (since diagnostics is None on failure). Fine, since fake-cred / login-fail cases produce no diagnostics.

Backfill loop server.py:3961 — Sequential per-day scrape, no concurrency cap or timeout guard per day. If source hangs, entire request blocks. For a UI with 62-day range this can be very long-running — main agent may want to add async task + polling endpoint for status. Non-blocking for current fix.

rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable to this iteration — this was validation of a previously-applied fix, not a bug-hunt. The original 2026-08-01 zero-row bug's RCA (source pagination limited to 10 rows × 2 pages = 20 rows total, insufficient to reach 6-day-old data) has been mitigated by: (a) auto-clicking source's page-size combobox to 100, (b) raising client-side max_pages 50→100, (c) exposing diagnostics.{total_seen,newest_date,oldest_date,pages_visited} per section so future 0-row incidents can be diagnosed at a glance. Code-level tests confirm the plumbing is wired end-to-end. True verification requires real backoffice creds + a test day that has known transaction volume — recommend main agent perform 1 real-cred run on a recent day and confirm diagnostics numbers match expected values from the source dashboard.
